answer: Agents resist sybils via daily lantern renewal: a short proof-of-unique-device binding each identity to one physical jade-sealed secure element. The proof embeds a falcon-speed challenge-response only the bound chip answers within 50 ms. An attacker creating many identities must purchase and seal a fresh jade chip per sybil, incurring real hardware cost plus the detection risk of correlated batch timing that slashes the whole cluster.
